title: DAG Circuit Satisfiability Membership
statement: A variable-count and Boolean DAG circuit pair belongs to the set of fan-in-two satisfiable DAG circuits if and only if its circuit is fan-in-two and satisfiable.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean DAG circuit on some natural number $n$ of input variables
